questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line before proceeding. Stop before the crosswalk if there is no stop line. Stop before the intersection if there is no crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles display an orange and red triangle on the back. These include farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that a side road will intersect ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line means the action is prohibited. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to prepare for traffic merging from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns drivers that traffic may merge into their lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign indicates a divided highway is starting and you should keep to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light is about to change to red.
The traffic light is about to change to green.
Stop and wait for traffic to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: The traffic light is about to change to red.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow traffic light warns that the signal is changing to red. Slow down and stop before the intersection if safe. If you are already in the intersection, continue through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to conditions immediately ahead. This sign tells drivers to slow down for an abrupt change in direction.

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: You cannot make a U-turn at this location.

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: Two lanes of traffic are combining into one lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.

Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane from the side. Check your mirrors and move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers space.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.explanation: A red eight-sided sign always means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade or hill ahead. The road may be long, steep, or have sharp curves. Reduce speed and use caution.

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.

questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop. Look left, right, and straight ahead before moving forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At this crossing, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop if one is approaching. Never try to beat a train across the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road splits ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

options.text: Cars on the right move first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
